l-e-m3-b07-08.title: Choose article wey meet all di conditions
l-e-m3-b07-08.goal: Think about all di conditions wey clash as you choose article to read for English homework, choose di best balance, and explain why.
l-e-m3-b07-08.material: You dey choose article to read for homework. Conditions: ① di topic na recycling, ② e report facts (no be opinion column), ③ you dey read 100 words per minute and must finish within 20 minutes.
l-e-m3-b07-08.s.s1.o.a: A: Recycling · article wey report facts · 2,400 words
l-e-m3-b07-08.s.s1.r.a: E go take 24 minutes, wey pass 20 minutes.
l-e-m3-b07-08.s.s1.r.b: E go take 12 minutes, but na column, no be article wey report facts.
l-e-m3-b07-08.s.s1.o.c: C: Sports · article wey report facts · 900 words
l-e-m3-b07-08.s.s1.r.c: E go take 9 minutes, but di topic no be recycling.
l-e-m3-b07-08.s.s1.o.d: D: Recycling · article wey report facts · 1,800 words
l-e-m3-b07-08.s.s1.explain: 1,800 ÷ 100 = 18 minutes, wey dey within 20 minutes. Di others break one rule about time, writing type, or topic.
l-e-m3-b07-08.s.s2.model.0: D na article wey report facts about recycling, and e go take 18 minutes to read, so e meet all three conditions.
l-e-m3-b07-08.s.s2.model.1: A go take 24 minutes, B na column, and C get different topic, so dem break di conditions and D na di best choice.
